conclusion: Version 1.3 defines the exact leader-portrait and technology-image AVM1 requests. MovieClipLoader.loadClip is registered at 0x8211DB70/0x8211DB74 to handler 0x82295018, which enforces two arguments, dispatches through packet +0x8 vtable slot +0x8, extracts both arguments, and builds request objects through 0x82229AA0 or 0x82229608. Function 0x82229C00 then performs the first owner-interface lookup and either hands the request to 0x82229518 or appends it to owner +0x220.
